comment: I have been a Park City resident since 2006. I am in favor of Rank Choice Voting (RCV) as I believe it will accomplish 2 important things: making it easier for individuals to run for office by making running for office less expensive and less time consuming. And this easing of entry will encourage better candidates who cannot afford the cost and time burdens of running for office. This is a win, win for Park City. Clearly there is a lot of negative noise being created by opponents who may have an interest in the old voting process. They are suggesting faults with little if any evidence to support the criticisms. Change always comes with naysayers who are afraid of trying different approaches. Please don't let these overpower the potentially great benefits of reducing both the costs and the time involved in running for office. Better candidates equals better government!
source: eComment (written; published verbatim in council meeting minutes)
